title: Russian Overnight Barrage Hits Kyiv Apartment Buildings, Kills One, Injures Nine
detail: Russia attacked Ukraine overnight into September 9 with 196 strike drones (Shahed, Gerbera and Parodiya decoys), S8000 Banderol munitions, and Iskander-M ballistic missiles. A drone strike hit a nine-story residential building in Kyiv's Dniprovskyi district, killing one woman and injuring at least three people including two teenagers (a 15-year-old boy and a 16-year-old girl). A separate jet-powered Banderol munition struck a 24-story residential building in the capital's Darnytskyi district the same morning, raising the citywide injury toll to nine.

title: Russian Drone Strike on Starokozache Checkpoint Kills Two on Ukraine-Moldova Border
detail: Russian forces struck the Starokozache international road checkpoint on Ukraine's border with Moldova (opposite Moldova's Tudora crossing) with attack drones on September 9, killing two people and wounding three. The strike hit the checkpoint's infrastructure and surrounding area, sparking fires and forcing the crossing's closure; rescue workers evacuated 16 people from the site. Russia's Defense Ministry said the checkpoint had been used to move military cargo into Ukraine. The checkpoint reopened later the same day.

title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Novorossiysk Naval Base, Oil Terminal and Frigate Admiral Essen
detail: Ukraine's General Staff and military intelligence (HUR) said Ukrainian drones struck Russia's Novorossiysk naval base and fuel oil terminal overnight into September 9, hitting the frigate Admiral Essen, Kalibr missile launcher positions, and the barracks of a Russian Unmanned Systems Forces company. President Zelensky said a terminal used for oil shipments, facilities within the military harbor, warships and Kalibr launchers were all struck. Krasnodar Krai Governor Veniamin Kondratyev said four people, including a child, were killed and 29 wounded; Russia's Defense Ministry said it intercepted or destroyed nearly 600 Ukrainian drones overnight nationwide.

title: Ukraine's SSO Hits Novy Urengoy Gas Plant 3,200 km Away — Deepest Strike of the War
detail: Ukraine's Special Operations Forces (SSO) struck the Novy Urengoy Gas Condensate Treatment Plant in Russia's Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug on September 9 — a target roughly 3,200 km from the Ukrainian border, the deepest strike of the full-scale war, surpassing the July 2026 Omsk refinery strike (~2,500 km). Ukrainian defense manufacturer Fire Point said its FP-1 attack drones flew through Russian-controlled airspace and multiple layers of electronic warfare without using GPS to reach the target. It was the first time Ukrainian forces struck the Yamalo-Nenets region. No map coordinates are plotted for this event as the target lies far outside this tracker's Ukraine-theater map bounds.

media.caption: Ukraine's deepest drone strike of the war hits a gas plant in Russia's Yamalo-Nenets region, Sept. 9, 2026
